book.name: Matius
book.title: Lele Pore Men Ia Tadulkon I MATIUS

content: Koparapaatna i Yesus nambantilkon se' i Ia bo papateion ka' bo potuo'ion
Sarataa i Yesus nangkakabusi tundunan-Na iya'a, Ia norobumo na murit-Na tae-Na,
“Kuu daa mingiti'i se' rua' ilio koini'i, takamo pangaramekonan Paska. Tempo iya'a, Anak Manusia bo rookonon ka' saliipkonon.”
Tempo iya'a nobarimpungmo a tanaasna imam tia motu-motu'ana lipu' Yahudi na laiganna Imam Moola' men ngaanna i Kayafas.
Raaya'a nopoosangadaimo mangarakop i Yesus wuni-wuni ka' mampapatei.
Kasee i raaya'a nangaan taena, “Amo'po wawauon na tempo ramean, dako' mantakakon kogora'an na mian biai'.”
Yesus nitimbu'i tia minamina'
Sarataa i Yesus na Betania, na laigan ni Simon men kustaon mbaripian,
notakamo ni Yesus a sa'angu' wiwine nangawawa sa'angu' botor pualam isiian minamina' men alayo' a ilina. Minamina' iya'a ia timbu'konmo na takala' ni Yesus men oru-oruang pintanga' kumaan.
Nimiile' men koiya'a murit-Na nomaso'mo ka' norobu taena, “Bo upa ka' mambaraba'i koi kani'i?
Gause minamina' kanono' sida balukkonon alayo' a ilina ka' doi'na sida rookonon bona mian men talalais.”
Kasee i Yesus inti-inti'i pikiranna i raaya'a kasi norobu tae-Na, “Nongko'upa i kuu se' mampapolosi noana wiwine kani'i? Ia nangawawaumo upa men pore na Ingku'.
Ka' mian talalais sinampang isian na ko'omuu, kasee i Yaku' sian sinampang isian na ko'omuu.
Gause ia nintimbu'kon minamina' iya'a na wakang-Ku, mbaka' ia nontoropotimo bo pantanoman i Yaku'.

Imamat a men taeng-Ku', ka' uga' bantilkonon-Ku na ko'omuu se' longkop tano' balaki', mau maana a pengelelekonan Lele Pore, ino'o uga' upa men ia wawaumo wiwine kani'i bo bantilkonon bookoi pinginau'an i ia.”
Yudas nangakalkon bo pongorookonna i Yesus
Mbaka' sa'angu' mian men tonsoop na sompulo' rua' murit iya'a, men ngaanna i Yudas Iskariot, nomae'mo nari tanaasna imam.
Ia norobu taena, “Upa a men bo rookononmuu na ingku' kalu yaku' mongorookon i Yesus na ko'omuu?” Raaya'a nambayar tolumpulo' doi' salaka' na ko'ona.
Supu iya'a i Yudas nansarakmo salan men daa pore bo pongorookonanna i Yesus na ko'ona i raaya'a.
Yesus tia murit-Na kumaan Paska
Na ilio tumbena pangaramekonan Roti Sianta Ragina notakamo ni Yesus a murit-Na ka' norobu taena, “Maana po'uus-Muu bo pontoropotianmai kakaan bo pangaramekonan Paska?”
Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Rae' na kota na sa'angu' mian ka' bantilkon na ko'ona inta': Potuunna Guru, tempong-Ku boomo taka. Yaku' mo'uus mangaramekon Paska ruru-ruru' tia murit-Ku na laiganmuu.”
Kasi murit-Na nangawawau koi men ia posuu'kon i Yesus ka' nontoropoti kumaanan Paska.
Sarataa malommo, Yesus no'umoruangmo kumaan ruru-ruru' tia sompulo' rua' murit-Na.
Pintanga' i raaya'a kumaan, Ia norobumo tae-Na, “Imamat ini'imari! Bantilkonon-Ku na ko'omuu se' isian i kuu men bo mongorookon i Yaku' kada' papateion.”
Kasi tia noa men masiongo' tuu' i raaya'a norobumo sa'angu'-sa'angu' taena, “Tumpu, taasi'po i yaku', indo'?”
Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Mian men mongorom rotina na lalomna mangko' patombongan kani'i tii Yaku', iamo a men bo mongorookon i Yaku'.
Anak Manusia tuutuu' bo lapus koi men nipoko tulismo na Alkitaap, kasee silaka' a mian men mongorookon Anak Manusia iya'a. Mian iya'a bagia sian nidodongokon.”
Yudas, men bo mongorookon i Yesus ninsimbati taena, “Guru, taasi'po i yaku', indo'?” Taeni Yesus na ko'ona, “Daa, koomo mba'a.”
Yesus nangawawau perjamuan tia murit-Na
Pintanga' kumaan i raaya'a, Yesus nangalamo roti, nobasukuur ka' nungurumpi-rumpik, kasi nongorookon na murit-Na ka' norobu tae-Na, “Alamo ka' kaan, ni'imo a wakang-Ku.”
Noko daa koiya'a, Ia ala a pinginuman tia anggur ka' nobasukuur na Alaata'ala kasi nongorookon i raaya'a ka' norobu tae-Na, “Pinginum i kuu giigii' na sasangkir kani'i.
Gause ni'imo a rara'-Ku men mamakadodor toonna Alaata'ala. Rara'-Ku tonturo' bona mian biai' bo pangampuni dosana i raaya'a.

Kasee bantilkonon-Ku na ko'omuu se' supu koini'i Yaku' sianmo minginum anggur soosoodo kani'i pataka na iliona men bo pinginuman-Kumo anggur men u'uru iya'a ruru-ruru' tii kuu na Batomundo'anna Tamang-Ku.”
Noko daa nangananikon nanian puntunde', ai Yesus tia murit-Na nomae'mo na Buu'na Zaitun.
Petrus bo minsasapu ni Yesus
Mbaka' i Yesus norobumo na ko'ona i raaya'a tae-Na, “Na malom kani'i uga' i kuu giigii' sianta mantaan a noamuu mamarasaya i Yaku'. Gause nipoko tulismo na Alkitaap koi kani'imari:

content.text: Yaku' bo mampapatei pontondongna domba ka' lulusanna domba bo bagera-gerap.

content: Kasee moko daa i Yaku' potuo'ion, Yaku' bo mongolukoni i kuu na Galilea.”
Ia simbati i Petrus taena, “Mau mune' i raaya'a giigii' sianta mantaan a noana mamarasaya i Kuu, kasee i yaku' sabole sian.”
Taeni Yesus na ko'ona, “Tuutuu' mba'a. Kasee bantilkonon-Ku na ko'oom se' rondommo kani'i koo'po tia siok muntuturuu', koo noko porotolumo ninsasapu na Ingku'.”
Ia simbati i Petrus taena, “Yaku' mau pate tii Kuu, sian minsasapu na Ko'omuu.” Giigii' murit men sambana uga' nangaan men koiya'a.
Yesus nosambayang na Getsemani
Mbaka' notakamo i Yesus tia murit-Na na tampat men ngaanon Getsemani. Kasi i Yesus norobu na murit-Na tae-Na, “Oruang karaa'ita. Yaku' dauga' kumbaale'e mae' sambayang.”
Ka' Ia nangawawa i Petrus tia anak ni Zebedeus rurua' mae' tii Ia. Muntumbeimo i Ia masiongo' ka' siasa.
Kasi i Ia norobu na ko'ona tae-Na, “Noang-Ku masiongo' tuu', koi se' kolapus-Kumo surion. Kuu ka'itamo tii Yaku' ka' maka'amat.”

Kasi i Ia nobalimba' ndee-ndee'e ka' nobanintuur tumutuku' rumbuk tano' ka' nosambayang, tae-Na, “Oo Tamang-Ku! Too daa sida oloakon na Ingku' a repaan men tio bo surion-Ku kani'i. Kasee alia koi men pingkira'-Ku, kasee uga' koi men pingkira'-Muu.”
Noko daa iya'a, Ia nombaale'emo na murit-Na. Ia takai i raaya'a nokoroyotmo. Kasi i Ia norobu ni Petrus tae-Na, “Sian mbali' i kuu momoko moburar badaga sa'angu' jaam tii Yaku'?
Maka'amat ka' basambayang dako' i kuu topongionna idek. Noamuu mo'uus mangawawau men kana', kasee i kuu sian mokotaan.”
Kasi i Ia nomae' men kopinduanna ka' nosambayang tae-Na, “Oo Tamang-Ku! Kalu repaan kani'i tio bo surion-Ku ka' sian sida oloakonon, patalaimo koi men po'uus-Muu!”
Ka' sarataa i Ia nde'emari soosoodo, Ia takai i raaya'a pintanga' royot, gause i raaya'a nototundo'mo.
Ia namarereimo i raaya'a indo'o ka' nomae' sambayang men koporotoluna. Sambayang-Na men ya'a-ya'amo.
Noko daa iya'a, Ia notakamo na murit-Na ka' norobu tae-Na, “Kuu dauga' royot tia mintimale? Piile'! Takamo a tempona Anak Manusia rookonon na limana mian men dosaon.
Wangonmo. Mai, kita mae'mo. Piile'! Mian men mongorookon i Yaku' karani'mo!”
Yesus nirakop

Pintanga' i Yesus dauga' morobu, notakamo i Yudas, sa'angu' mian men tonsoop sompulo' rua' murit ni Yesus. Ka' men nongololo' i ia mian biai' potowawa bakoko' tia popool, ia posuu' tanaasna imam tia motu-motu'ana lipu' Yahudi.
Mian men mongorookon i Yesus noko pambantilkonmo oosan kani'imari na ko'ona i raaya'a: “Mian men ookionku, ya'amo i Ia. Rakop i Ia.”
Mbaka' i Yudas liuliu nuntuu'i i Yesus ka' norobu taena, “Tabea', Guru!” Kasi ia nongooki i Yesus.
Kasee i Yesus norobu tae-Na, “Oo bela', supu-supuanna koiya'a i koo taka?” Mbaka' i raaya'a nuntuu'imo i Yesus ka' nangarakop.
Kasee sa'angu' mian men nongololo' i Yesus numbubut bakoko'na ka' nontotok ata'na Imam Moola' tamban nokopantas a tilinganna.
Mbaka' taeni Yesus, “Soopkon soosoodo a bakoko'om na guma'na, gause giigii' mian men mamake bakoko' bo pate tia bakoko'.
Kabai punsuriim se' i Yaku' sian momoko mama'ase' na Tamang-Ku kada' i Ia liuliu momosuu' labi tia sompulo' rua' pasukan malaa'ikat bo puntulung i Yaku'?
Kasee kalu i Yaku' mikitulung na Tamang-Ku, mbaka' koi upa a bo kosidana men nitulismo na Alkitaap men mangaan se' tio sida koi kani'i?”

Tempo iya'a i Yesus norobu na mian biai' tae-Na, “Pansaruimuu se' i Yaku' too mian puraga mbali' i kuu taka poto'inton bakoko' tia popool bo pangarakop i Yaku'? Sanda' ilio i Yaku' no'umoruang mimisiso' mian na tolodona Laiganna Alaata'ala, see i kuu sian nangarakop i Yaku'.
Kasee giigii' kani'i tio sida kada' sidamo a men nitulis na kitapna nabii.” Kasi giigii' murit-Na kabus namarere ka' namarerei i Ia.
Yesus na aropna Mahkama Agama
Noko daa i raaya'a nangarakop i Yesus, ia wawamo i raaya'a ni Kayafas men Imam Moola'. Indo'o isian wawa ukum Torat tia motu-motu'a men nobarimpungmo.
Ka' i Petrus nuntuntuni i Ia kasee olo-oloa mae' na tolodona Imam Moola' ka' sarataa ninsoop na tolodo, ia no'umoruang tari dadagai mempeperai kowawasanna parakala iya'a.
Tanaasna imam tia giigii' mianna Mahkama Agama mansarak mian bo pomborekkon i Yesus kada' Ia tio ukumon pate.
Kasee i raaya'a sian nantausi sala'-Na, mau mune' biai' a mian men nitakakon bo pomborekkon i Ia. Komburi'na notakamo a mian rurua',
men nangaan taena, “Mian kani'i nangaan tae-Na: Yaku' sida munguruntuni Laiganna Alaata'ala ka' mangawangonkon soosoodo na lalomna tolu' ilio.”
Kasi Imam Moola' iya'a nokumekerer ka' norobu ni Yesus taena, “Sian simbatioon a upa men ia raitkon mian karaaya'a na Ko'oom?”
Kasee i Yesus tongko' roko-rokot. Kasi taena Imam Moola' na Ko'ona, “Mimpu'u na Alaata'ala men tumuo', bantilkon na ko'omai, too i Koo a Tomundo' Pansalamatkon, Anakna Alaata'ala, kabai taasi'.”

Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Daa. Kuu poko ngaanmo. Kasee bantilkonon-Ku na ko'omuu se' supu koini'i kuu bo mimiile' Anak Manusia umoruang paraas uananna Alaata'ala men Pungkuasai, ka' taka ra'amari na wawona antong na langit.”
Mbaka' Imam Moola' iya'a nemberakmo pakeanna ka' norobu taena, “Ia mingidek Alaata'ala. Bo upa ka' dauga' mansarak mian bo pinginti'ianta. Koini'i daa kuu rongormo i Ia ningidek Alaata'ala.
Koi upa a pinginti'imuu?” Raaya'a ninsimbati taena, “Ia tio ukumon pate.”
Kasi i raaya'a ninginori ro'up-Na ka' isian uga' men numukul ka' nampapagi i Ia,
ka' norobu taena, “Io, Tomundo' Pansalamatkon! Bantilkon na ko'omai se' ime a men numukul i Koo.”
Petrus ninsasapu ni Yesus
Petrus oru'oruang na liwana laigan na tolodo. Mbaka' notakamo a sa'angu' ata' wiwine na ko'ona ka' norobu taena, “Kuu uga' sinampang poololo' tii Yesus, samba Galilea iya'a.”
Kasee ia ninsasapu na giigii' mian taena, “Sian inti'ionku upa a panduuwung.”
Sarataa ia nomae' na soopanna tolodo, sa'angu' ata' wiwine sambanaan nimiile' i ia ka' norobu na mian men iraando'o taena, “Mian kani'i poopoololo' tii Yesus, samba Nazaret iya'a.”
Ka' ia ninsasapu soosoodo ka' nobasumpa' taena, “Yaku' mase sian inti'ionku inooro'o mian.”
Sian paraa nanau' mian men isian iraando'o notakamo ni Petrus ka' norobu taena, “Sabole i koo uga' tonsoop tii raaya'a. Men koiya'a nirongor na wuruung.”
Mbaka' i Petrus nuntumbeimo nobatadean ka' nobasumpa' taena, “Yaku' mase sian inti'ionku inooro'o mian.” Ka' na tempo iya'a nuntuturuu'mo a siok.

Mbaka' notonginau'mo i Petrus upa men ia bantilkonmo i Yesus na ko'ona tae-Na, “Koo'po tia siok muntuturuu' i koo noko porotolumo minsasapu na Ingku'.” Mbaka' no'umuarmo i Petrus ka' nowiri tamban bolingongoton.
